summary: ProKidney Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus for an at-the-market offering of up to $200,000,000 of Class A common stock through Jefferies LLC as sales agent under an Open Market Sale Agreement. Shares trade on Nasdaq under PROK, closing at $1.13 on November 11, 2026. Jefferies receives commissions up to 3.0% of gross proceeds and sells on a best-efforts basis with no escrow. No board recommendation, premium, or advisor opinion is stated. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and any acceleration in ATM usage.
